owners.label: Crimson Light
owners.description: Damage of Resonance Skill Crimson Erosion triggered by Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades is increased by 20%. The HP cost and stacks of Ruby Blossom recovered are doubled.

owners.label: Overflow
owners.description: After casting the Resonance Skill Sanguine Pulse, Danjin's Heavy Attack DMG is increased by 30% for 5s.

owners.label: Duality
owners.description: The incoming Resonator has their Havoc DMG Amplified by 23% for 14s or until they are switched out.

owners.label: Crimson Heart of Justice
owners.description: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her ATK is increased by 5% for 6s, stacking up to 6 times. Danjin loses 1 stacks of this effect each time she takes damage.

owners.label: Dusted Mirror
owners.description: When Danjin attacks a target with Resonance Skill's Incinerating Will, her damage dealt is increased by 20%.

owners.label: Fleeting Blossom
owners.description: Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus is increased by 30%.

owners.label: Solitary Carnation
owners.description:
When Danjin has more than 60 "Ruby Blossom", her Crit. Rate is increased by 15%.
This effect lasts until the end of Heavy Attack: Scatterbloom even after all "Ruby Blossom" is consumed when casting Heavy Attack: Chaoscleave.

owners.label: Reigning Blade
owners.description: Danjin's Havoc DMG Bonus is increased by 15%, and further increased by another 15% when her HP is lower than 60%.

owners.label: Bloodied Jade
owners.description: Heavy Attack Chaoscleave increases the ATK of all team members by 20% for 20s.

owners.label: Incinerating Will
owners.description: Danjin is attacking a target marked with Incinerating Will.

owners.label: Duality
owners.description: Danjin grants Havoc amplification to the incoming Resonator.

owners.label: Bloodied Jade
owners.description: Danjin grants team ATK after Chaoscleave.
